result:
The users page now has a search box (name or email), a role filter, and an Export CSV button above the table. Nothing was run, per your instruction, so this is untested and not type-checked or linted.

- **Filtering**: search and role filter work together and run in the browser on the already-loaded users list, so the API and mock handlers are unchanged. Search is case-insensitive and matches full name or email.
- **Export**: downloads `users.csv` with exactly the rows currently shown, with columns Name, Email, Role, Joined. The button is disabled when no users match.
- **CSV details**: the Joined date uses the same format as the table (`formatDate`). Cells that start with `=`, `+`, `-` or `@` get a leading `'` so that spreadsheet apps do not run them as formulas.
- **Admin only**: the page was already restricted to admins by the route, so I added no new role check.

The changes are in `src/features/users/components/users-list.tsx` and a new `src/utils/csv.ts`.

The filter fields use `Input` and `Select` from `@/components/ui/form` as controlled fields without a surrounding `Form`, because nothing is submitted or validated.
